post.description:
## Query Task Status
After submitting the task, you can check the progress of the task and obtain the generated results through the unified query endpoint: 
<Card title="Get Task Details" icon="lucide-search" href="/market/common/get-task-detail">
 Learn how to check the task status and obtain the generated results 
</Card> 

::: tip[]
In the production environment, it is recommended to use the "callBackUrl" parameter to receive the automatic notification upon completion of the generation, rather than polling the status endpoint. 
:::

Related resources
<CardGroup cols={2}>
  <Card title="Market Overview" icon="lucide-store" href="/market/quickstart"> View all available models </Card>
  <Card title="General API" icon="lucide-cog" href="/common-api/get-account-credits"> View account credits and usage </Card>
</CardGroup>

model.description: The model name used for generation. This endpoint must use `flux-3/klein-edit-image`.

callBackUrl.description:
The URL to receive generation task completion updates. Optional but recommended for production use. The system POSTs the task status and results to this URL when generation completes.

To ensure callback security, see [Webhook Verification Guide](/common-api/webhook-verification).

input.description: Input parameters for the generation task

prompt.description: An instruction describing how to edit the image (Max length: 5000 characters)

image_urls.description: Input images to transform or use as reference (supports up to 10 images) (File URL after upload, not file content; Accepted types: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp; Max size: 30.0MB)

aspect_ratio.description:
Aspect ratio of the generated image. Select auto to match the first input image ratio.
Options: 1:1; 4:3; 3:4; 3:2; 2:3; 16:9; 9:16; 21:9; 9:21; auto

resolution.description:
Resolution of the generated image
Options: 1K; 2K; 4K

width.description: Width of the generated image. Both width and height must be passed at the same time. Must be an integer between 256 and 4096. The aspect ratio (width:height) must be between 1:2.5 and 2.5:1. Once passed, aspect_ratio and resolution are ignored.

height.description: Height of the generated image. Both width and height must be passed at the same time. Must be an integer between 256 and 4096. The aspect ratio (width:height) must be between 1:2.5 and 2.5:1. Once passed, aspect_ratio and resolution are ignored.

output_format.description:
Format of the output image
Options: png; jpeg; webp

enhance_prompt.description: Rewrites the prompt into a fuller description before generating, which noticeably improves quality. Enabled by default (also when the parameter is omitted); pass false to turn it off. Applies to both text-to-image and image editing; in editing, the rewrite preserves the intent of the original instruction.

nsfw_checker.description: Defaults to false. When false, no additional content filtering is applied and results are returned directly by the model.

input.prompt: Change the backpack to dark green and keep everything else unchanged

post.description: Sent when the task succeeds or fails.

code.description: 200: success. 501: failure; see data.failCode and data.failMsg.

completeTime.description: Task completion time, represented as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds

costTime.description: Processing time in seconds. Present on both success and failure callbacks.

createTime.description: Task creation time, represented as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds

creditsConsumed.description: Credits consumed by the task; 0 for failed tasks. 1K = 1.6 / image, 2K = 2.5, 4K = 6.5; billed per output image.

model.description: Image generation model used for the task

param.description: Parameters submitted when creating the task, in JSON string format
param.example: {"model": "flux-3/klein-edit-image", "callBackUrl": "https://your-domain.com/api/callback", "input": "{\"prompt\": \"Change the backpack to dark green and keep everything else unchanged\", \"image_urls\": [\"https://example.com/input.jpg\"], \"aspect_ratio\": \"auto\", \"resolution\": \"1K\", \"output_format\": \"png\", \"num_images\": 1, \"enhance_prompt\": false}"}

resultJson.description: Image generation result in JSON string format. resultUrls contains the list of generated image URLs. Present only when state is success.

updateTime.description: Use completeTime as the completion time; updateTime may equal createTime.

failCode.description: Failure code, a numeric string such as "400" or "500". Present only when state is fail.

failMsg.description: Failure reason. Present only when state is fail.

data.param: {"model": "flux-3/klein-edit-image", "callBackUrl": "https://your-domain.com/api/callback", "input": "{\"prompt\": \"Change the backpack to dark green and keep everything else unchanged\", \"image_urls\": [\"https://example.com/input.jpg\"], \"aspect_ratio\": \"auto\", \"resolution\": \"1K\", \"output_format\": \"png\", \"num_images\": 1, \"enhance_prompt\": false}"}

{"model": "flux-3/klein-edit-image", "callBackUrl": "https://your-domain.com/api/callback", "input": "{\"prompt\": \"Change the backpack to dark green and keep everything else unchanged\", \"image_urls\": [\"https://example.com/input.jpg\"], \"aspect_ratio\": \"auto\", \"resolution\": \"1K\", \"output_format\": \"png\", \"num_images\": 1, \"enhance_prompt\": false}"}

nsfw_checker.description: Defaults to false. When false, no additional content filtering is applied and results are returned directly by the model.

code.description: Status code of the request. The HTTP status is 200 even when the request fails, so always check this field: 200 means success; any other value means the request failed and msg describes the reason. Common values: 401 invalid or missing API key; 402 insufficient credits; 429 rate limit exceeded; 422 or 500 the request could not be processed (read msg and check your parameters before retrying).

msg.description: Response message, error description upon failure

taskId.description: The task ID can be used with the "Get Task Details" endpoint to query the task status.

BearerAuth.description: All API requests require a Bearer Token. Add the header `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY` to authenticate requests.
